subject: Film & Cinema
title: The Rise of A24 and Indie Studios
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Rise of A24 and Indie Studios usable.

hook.text: A24 turned art-house films into cultural events — and made audiences crave originality.

buildup.text: Founded in 2012, A24 released films studios considered too weird or too small.

discovery.text: Moonlight, Lady Bird, and Everything Everywhere proved odd films could win audiences and Oscars.

twist.text: A24's success relied on branding and social media as much as the films themselves.

climax.text: They proved a sustainable model exists between mega-blockbusters and micro-budget obscurity.

punchline.text: Weird became the most bankable brand.

quiz.question: What made A24 distinctive in the film industry?
options: Releasing unconventional films that became cultural events
